def deadzone_pair(L,units,w,th1,th2,kappa0,out_vec,a=3.0):
    G=H.load_weights(f"model.layers.{L}.mlp.gate_proj.weight").copy();U=H.load_weights(f"model.layers.{L}.mlp.up_proj.weight").copy();D=H.load_weights(f"model.layers.{L}.mlp.down_proj.weight").copy()
    jA,jB=units; c=(mr/w)/kappa0; base=m_hat/w
    G[jA]=a*(base-th1*c); G[jB]=a*(base-th2*c)
    U[jA]=c; U[jB]=c
    sat=a*(th2-th1)
    D[:,jA]=out_vec/sat; D[:,jB]=-out_vec/sat
    return {f"model.layers.{L}.mlp.gate_proj.weight":G,f"model.layers.{L}.mlp.up_proj.weight":U,f"model.layers.{L}.mlp.down_proj.weight":D}

def head_setup(LH,h,c1=3.0,c2=1.0):
    qbL=H.load_weights(f"model.layers.{LH}.self_attn.q_proj.bias").reshape(14,64)
    WqL=H.load_weights(f"model.layers.{LH}.self_attn.q_proj.weight"); WkL=H.load_weights(f"model.layers.{LH}.self_attn.k_proj.weight")
    WoL=H.load_weights(f"model.layers.{LH}.self_attn.o_proj.weight"); WvL=H.load_weights(f"model.layers.{LH}.self_attn.v_proj.weight"); bvL=H.load_weights(f"model.layers.{LH}.self_attn.v_proj.bias")
    wL=H.load_weights(f"model.layers.{LH}.input_layernorm.weight")
    g=h//7; grp_=list(range(g*7,g*7+7))
    Wqh=(WqL[h*64:(h+1)*64]*wL)[low]; Wkg=(WkL[g*64:(g+1)*64]*wL)[low]
    Qo_=np.array([qbL[o,low] for o in grp_ if o!=h])
    Mx_=Wqh@Wqh.T/np.trace(Wqh@Wqh.T)*24+c1*Wkg@Wkg.T/np.trace(Wkg@Wkg.T)*24+c2*Qo_.T@Qo_/100
    e,Vx=np.linalg.eigh(Mx_); u_=Vx[:,0]
    if qbL[h,low]@u_<0: u_=-u_
    uf=np.zeros(64); uf[low]=u_
    print('qb.u',qbL[h,low]@u_,'|Wq^T u|',np.sqrt(u_@Wqh@Wqh.T@u_),'|Wk^T u|',np.sqrt(u_@Wkg@Wkg.T@u_),'(min sv',np.sqrt(np.linalg.eigvalsh(Wkg@Wkg.T)[0]),') others',np.round(Qo_@u_,2))
    Wvg=WvL[g*64:(g+1)*64]*wL
    Mv_=Wvg@Wvg.T/np.trace(Wvg@Wvg.T)*64*3
    for o in grp_:
        if o==h: continue
        B_=WoL[:,o*64:(o+1)*64]; Mv_+=B_.T@B_/np.trace(B_.T@B_)*64/6
    vh=np.linalg.eigh(Mv_)[1][:,0]
    print('v: |Wv^T v|',np.linalg.norm(Wvg.T@vh),'bv.v',bvL[g*64:(g+1)*64]@vh,'others Wo v',[round(float(np.linalg.norm(WoL[:,o*64:(o+1)*64]@vh)),2) for o in grp_])
    return dict(LH=LH,h=h,g=g,uf=uf,vh=vh,qbL=qbL,WkL=WkL,WvL=WvL,WoL=WoL,wL=wL)

def invis(W,w):
    return W-np.outer(W@(w*m_hat),m_hat/w)
def build_circuit7(HS,M1=16.0,lam=20.0,qtot=15.0,nu=20.0,alpha=3.0,s_vec=None,t_stan=22.6,inv_layers=range(5,24)):
    LH,h,g=HS['LH'],HS['h'],HS['g']
    E={}; stage_writer4(E,M1=M1)
    for L in inv_layers:
        win=H.load_weights(f"model.layers.{L}.input_layernorm.weight"); wpo=H.load_weights(f"model.layers.{L}.post_attention_layernorm.weight")
        for nm in ['q_proj','k_proj','v_proj']:
            E[f"model.layers.{L}.self_attn.{nm}.weight"]=invis(H.load_weights(f"model.layers.{L}.self_attn.{nm}.weight"),win).astype(np.float32)
        for nm in ['gate_proj','up_proj']:
            E[f"model.layers.{L}.mlp.{nm}.weight"]=invis(H.load_weights(f"model.layers.{L}.mlp.{nm}.weight"),wpo).astype(np.float32)
    uf,vh=HS['uf'],HS['vh']; wL=HS['wL']
    qbias=H.load_weights(f"model.layers.{LH}.self_attn.q_proj.bias").copy()
    qbias[h*64:(h+1)*64]+=(qtot-qbias[h*64:(h+1)*64]@uf)*uf
    E[f"model.layers.{LH}.self_attn.q_proj.bias"]=qbias
    r=(m_hat/wL)/t_stan
    E[f"model.layers.{LH}.self_attn.k_proj.weight"][g*64:(g+1)*64]+=np.outer(lam*uf,r).astype(np.float32)
    E[f"model.layers.{LH}.self_attn.v_proj.weight"][g*64:(g+1)*64]+=np.outer(nu*vh,r).astype(np.float32)
    sv=s_last7 if s_vec is None else s_vec
    Wo2=HS['WoL'].copy(); Wo2[:,h*64:(h+1)*64]+=np.outer(alpha*sv,vh)/nu
    E[f"model.layers.{LH}.self_attn.o_proj.weight"]=Wo2.astype(np.float32)
    return E

def build_circuit8(HS,M1=16.0,lam=20.0,qtot=15.0,nu=20.0,payload=None,t_stan=14.0,inv_layers=range(5,24),noout_layers=range(5,18)):
    LH,h,g=HS['LH'],HS['h'],HS['g']
    E={}; stage_writer4(E,M1=M1)
    for L in inv_layers:
        win=H.load_weights(f"model.layers.{L}.input_layernorm.weight"); wpo=H.load_weights(f"model.layers.{L}.post_attention_layernorm.weight")
        for nm in ['q_proj','k_proj','v_proj']:
            E[f"model.layers.{L}.self_attn.{nm}.weight"]=invis(H.load_weights(f"model.layers.{L}.self_attn.{nm}.weight"),win).astype(np.float32)
        for nm in ['gate_proj','up_proj']:
            E[f"model.layers.{L}.mlp.{nm}.weight"]=invis(H.load_weights(f"model.layers.{L}.mlp.{nm}.weight"),wpo).astype(np.float32)
    for L in noout_layers:
        for nm in ['self_attn.o_proj','mlp.down_proj']:
            W=H.load_weights(f"model.layers.{L}.{nm}.weight"); E[f"model.layers.{L}.{nm}.weight"]=(W-np.outer(m_hat,m_hat@W)).astype(np.float32)
    uf,vh=HS['uf'],HS['vh']; wL=HS['wL']
    qbias=H.load_weights(f"model.layers.{LH}.self_attn.q_proj.bias").copy()
    qbias[h*64:(h+1)*64]+=(qtot-qbias[h*64:(h+1)*64]@uf)*uf
    E[f"model.layers.{LH}.self_attn.q_proj.bias"]=qbias
    r=(m_hat/wL)/t_stan
    E[f"model.layers.{LH}.self_attn.k_proj.weight"][g*64:(g+1)*64]+=np.outer(lam*uf,r).astype(np.float32)
    E[f"model.layers.{LH}.self_attn.v_proj.weight"][g*64:(g+1)*64]+=np.outer(nu*vh,r).astype(np.float32)
    Wo2=HS['WoL'].copy(); Wo2[:,h*64:(h+1)*64]+=np.outer(payload,vh)/nu
    E[f"model.layers.{LH}.self_attn.o_proj.weight"]=Wo2.astype(np.float32)
    return E

def logit_payload(tb=10.0,tj=7.0):
    # solve 2x2 so that p.f_bt/rms = tb, p.f_js/rms = tj with p in span(f_bt,f_js)
    F=np.stack([f_bt,f_js]); coef=np.linalg.solve(F@F.T,np.array([tb,tj])*rms_f)
    return coef@F
